qa.title: Q&A
qa.description: Curated pairs are searched on their own for every visitor message and, on a hit, answered before any knowledge-base passage. Adding or editing one never needs a reindex.
qa.question: Question
qa.questionPlaceholder: e.g. How long is your refund window?
qa.answerPlaceholder: e.g. Refunds are accepted within 30 days of delivery.
qa.questionTooShort: The question needs at least 15 characters
qa.emptyHint: Add a pair so a fixed answer outranks the knowledge base.
qa.deleteConfirm: Delete this Q&A pair? The question falls back to knowledge-base retrieval.
qa.toggleHint: A disabled pair no longer affects answers but stays in the list.
qa.importDescription: Separate pairs with a blank line: the first line is the question, the remaining lines are the answer. Duplicates and blank rows are skipped.
qa.importPlaceholder:
How long is your refund window?
Refunds are accepted within 30 days of delivery.

Which payment methods do you support?
WeChat Pay and Alipay.

fixedFacts.description: Everything written here is injected into every prompt, after Q&A hits and before knowledge-base passages, up to 6 passages. Put facts that must always be exact here — address, refund policy, booking link.

fixedFacts.placeholder:
Address: 3F, 100 Hengshan Road, Xuhui District, Shanghai.

Booking link: https://booking.example.com/new?ref=basjoo
fixedFacts.hint: Each blank-line-separated passage is one fact; at most 6 are injected.
fixedFacts.linkHint: Links written here are reproduced verbatim.

procedures.stepTextPlaceholder: e.g. Confirm whether the visitor wants a refund or an exchange.

procedures.emptyHint: Add a procedure to walk multi-turn conversations through fixed steps.
procedures.unavailableActionHint: If a step needs an action the channel does not support (phone, for example), the whole procedure is skipped.

webhooks.secretSetHint: A secret is stored. Leave this field empty to keep it, or type a new one to replace it.
